## Circular to Licensed Corporations which are Engaged in Asset Management and/or Giving Advice on Funds/Portfolios

## Fund Management Activities Survey 2005

As an annual exercise to collect information on fund m anagement activities in Hong Kong for regulatory and market facilitation purposes and to better understand the competitive edge of the  sector,  we  have  now  commenced  the  Fund  Management  Activities  Survey  2005  (the 'FMAS').    We  would  appreciate  your  continued  co-operation,  as  in  previous  years,  by completing and returning the attached Questionnaire on or before 27 March 2006 .

For those licensed corporations who have completed the FMAS 2004, please complete the FMAS 2005 . For those licensed corporations who  have not completed the FMAS 2004 but,  as  of  31  December  2005,  have  had  gross  operating  income  derived  from  asset management and/or giving advice on funds/portfolios, please also complete the FMAS 2005. A copy of the Questionnaire can be downloaded from the Commission's website at:

http://www.sfc.hk/sfc/doc/EN/forms/products/FMAS\_2005\_LC.xlt (Please enable Macros when opening the Excel file)

To reduce the amount of paper work and facilitate data analysis, you are encouraged to submit your completed survey in electronic format by means of a floppy disk or CD.  Please refer to the cover sheet of the Questionnaire for details.

Please read the Guidance Notes annexed to the Questionnaire prior to completing the survey. Please rest assured that all information supplied will be treated in strict confidence and will not be disclosed to any third party except in the form of statistics.

If you have any queries on the FMAS or need a hard copy of the Questionnaire, please contact the Investment Products Department at (852) 2842-7712 if your company begins with the letter A - M, or (852) 2840-9592 if your company begins with the letter N - Z.
